correctness.rationale: The two graph components are Möbius automorphisms. Haar invariance gives normalized pullback invariance. Almost invariance forces invariance modulo Haar under the irrational rotation, hence zero-one measure. On the chosen arc the identity branch gives first return time one while the rotation branch leaves the arc, so the induced correspondence is the identity and a half-arc has induced measure one half. All steps are exact.

value.rationale: The source presents induced ergodicity as a central structural theorem. The finding settles the uncertainty decisively by showing the theorem is false in a transparent degree-two, non-atomic model and isolates the branch-discarding mechanism any repair must address.
